title: Ordered quotient frames on one affine base open
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], A its canonical symmetric graded algebra [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], P=Proj_S(A) [def-nagata-relative-proj], p:P→S, and D a normalized tautological quotient datum [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Fix r∈ℕ, an ordered free-module isomorphism b:O_S^(r+1)≅E, a scheme isomorphism eRel:P≅RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r [def-nagata-relative-projective-space], and a scheme isomorphism theta:RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r≅ProjectiveSpace(ULift(Fin(r+1)),S). Fix a single affine base open V, an AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V, and IsIntegralProjComparison for theta at V [lem-trf-free-projective-bundle-base-change-space]. Set f=theta∘eRel and let sigma be the section-normalized adjoint of D.quotient using [def-pc-module-pullback]. For each ordered basis index i let q_i=sigma_top(b(e_i)) be the global section of D.line. On W_i=p^{-1}(V)∩f^{-1}(D_+(X_i)), q_i is a free generator. For every ordered j, q_j|W_i equals the restriction of f^*(X_j/X_i) times q_i|W_i, where X_j/X_i is the standard projective coordinate ratio [def-sfb-projective-coordinate-section] and D.chart uses the degree-one Proj twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. There is no global isomorphism or gluing conclusion. The local comparison hypotheses suffice without separate global over-S equations.

proof.text: Fix one affine base open V and unpack its AffineFreeComparison into the graded polynomial isomorphism beta, the chart maps eC and eR, and their equations. The normalized gamma from the coefficient polynomial ring composed with integral coefficient extension is the prescribed integralPolynomialMap: polynomial extensionality checks constants and each ordered variable. IsIntegralProjComparison and functoriality of Proj therefore identify the composite of the symmetric chart with eRel, theta and toProjInt with Proj.map of beta composed with coefficient extension. In particular its inverse image of D_+(X_i) is D_+(iota(b(e_i))).

Naturality of the adjoint quotient identifies its value on the basis section over V with the restriction of its value on the global basis section. Apply the generator equation of D and naturality of its chart isomorphism. The pullback of the global quotient section q_i becomes exactly iota(b(e_i))/1 in the symmetric degree-one twist, on every subopen of the affine chart.

On D_+(iota(b(e_i))), the section iota(b(e_i))/1 is a free generator. Transport this across D.chart. Restriction along the affine chart open immersion reflects this freeness, since its structural ring maps and the module pullback-unit maps are bijective on subopens of the image. Thus q_i is a free generator on p^{-1}(V) intersect f^{-1}(D_+(X_i)).

The homogeneous localization identity gives q_j=(iota(b(e_j))/iota(b(e_i))) q_i after applying D.chart. The formula for Proj.map on degree-zero fractions identifies that ratio with the pullback of the standard coordinate ratio X_j/X_i. Injectivity of restriction along the affine chart transports the equality back to the displayed open. The same formulas hold for zero rings, empty opens, and the one-coordinate case r=0.

theorem ordered_quotient_affine_frames (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (r : ℕ) (b : RelativeProjectiveSpace.freeModule S r ≅ E)
    (eRel : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj ≅
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r)
    (θ : RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r ≅ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S))
    (V : S.affineOpens)
    (hAffine : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V)
    (hθAffine : RelativeProjectiveSpace.IsIntegralProjComparison S r V
      (RelativeProjectiveSpace.affineToIntegral S r θ V)) :
    let p := (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom
    let f := (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom
    let σ := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction p).homEquiv E D.line D.quotient
    let s (i : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) : Γ(D.line, ⊤) :=
      σ.app ⊤ (b.hom.app ⊤ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := S.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op ⊤) (1 : Γ(S, ⊤))))
    ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)),
      let W := p ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveSpace.standardOpen _ S i
      Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator
        (D.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s i)) ∧
      ∀ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)),
        D.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s j) =
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveSpace.standardOpen _ S i)).op
              (f.app (ProjectiveSpace.standardOpen _ S i)
                (ProjectiveSpace.coordRatio _ S i j))) •
            D.line.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s i)
